realism.thirst.2: You're dizzy from thirst. Find water!
realism.thirst.3: You're collapsing from thirst. DRINK NOW!
realism.sleep.2: You're nodding off. You need to sleep.
realism.sleep.3: You're hearing things that aren't there... SLEEP!
realism.sleep.rested: You slept well and feel rested.
realism.stamina.breathing: You're out of breath. Stop and rest.
realism.stamina.shaky: Your legs are shaking. Rest or you'll pass out!
realism.tear: Ouch! You tore a muscle in your arm. Slow down.
realism.tear.bad: You tore it again, badly. That needs a doctor.
realism.leg.rock: CRACK! You landed on rock and badly broke your leg.
realism.burn.1: Ow! 1st degree burn. Don't touch a working furnace!
realism.burn.2: 2nd degree burn! Blisters on your hand.
realism.burn.3: 3rd degree burn! That needs a hospital.
realism.frostbite: Frostbite! Your fingers and toes are freezing. Get warm!
realism.bleed.1: You're bleeding a little. It should stop on its own.
realism.bleed.2: You're bleeding heavily! Use a bandage.
realism.bleed.3: SEVERE bleeding! Put a tourniquet on NOW!
realism.bandage.too_much: Too much bleeding for a bandage. Use a tourniquet!
realism.tourniquet.done: Tourniquet on. The bleeding is held, but you'll move slower.
realism.tourniquet.not_needed: A tourniquet is only for severe bleeding.
realism.syringe.too_little: Not enough blood to give right now.
realism.transfusion.full: There's no room for more blood.
realism.transfusion.reaction: Wrong blood type! %s doesn't match %s. You feel very sick.
item.realism.bandage.tip: Stops light and heavy bleeding. Use on yourself or a player.
item.realism.tourniquet.tip: Holds severe bleeding. You move slower while it's on.
item.realism.syringe.tip: Draws 0.5 l of blood into a blood bag (yourself or a player).
item.realism.blood_bag.tip: Gives 0.5 l of blood. The blood type must match!
realism.neck: CRACK! You broke your neck. Don't move much and get to a hospital for surgery!
realism.surgery.no_doctor: You need a Doctor nearby (a villager working at a Medical Station).
realism.surgery.done: Surgery done. You wake up groggy, but you're fixed up.
realism.cream.healed: The burn cream healed your burn.
realism.cream.helped: The burn cream soothes it. A 3rd degree burn still takes time (or surgery).
realism.splint.done: Splinted. Your leg will heal 3x faster.
realism.fiberglass.itch: Itchy! Don't touch fiberglass with bare hands.
realism.fiberglass.cough: *cough cough* Wear a helmet/mask when breaking fiberglass!
realism.mood.1: You're feeling down. Friends, pets, music or a good game might help.
realism.mood.2: You're feeling really low. Spend time with friends, rest, or see a Doctor for therapy. It gets better.
realism.console.fun: You played some games. That was fun!
realism.console.again: You just played. Give it a minute.
realism.tv.fun: You watched a show and laughed a lot.
realism.tv.again: You just watched something. Give it a minute.
realism.therapy.done: You talked things through with the Doctor and feel much lighter. (In real life too: talking to someone you trust really helps.)
item.realism.part.tip: Right-click a PC Case with it to install it.
realism.pc.no_power: No power! Give the PC Case a redstone signal (plug it in).
realism.pc.sag: ⚠ Your GPU is sagging! Install an Anti-Sag Bracket. (%s boots left before it cracks)
realism.pc.cracked: CRACK! Your GPU sagged so much it broke. Buy a new one (and a bracket!).
realism.pc.game: You played a game on your computer. Fun!
realism.datacenter.ate: The AI ate it. It wants MORE.
realism.datacenter.hungry: The AI only eats RAM, GPUs and CPUs. Lots of them.
realism.collapse.you: You collapsed. Someone has to save you, fast...
realism.collapse.other: %s COLLAPSED! at %s %s %s. Defibrillator (charge, clear, shock), or call an ambulance (phone or /ambulance), quick!
realism.revived: You're back! Take it easy for a while.
realism.gone.spectator: You died for good. You can only watch now.
realism.gone.new_person: You died for good. You start over as a new person.
realism.defib.no_patient: Look at a collapsed player within 3 blocks.
realism.defib.order: Wrong order: charge, then clear, then shock.
realism.ambulance.no_hospital: No hospital found (place an Operating Table).
realism.ambulance.sent: The ambulance rushes %s to the hospital!
realism.ambulance.no_doctor: You're at the hospital, but there's no Doctor! Someone has to defib you.
realism.neck.paralysed: You broke your neck and can't move your body! Someone needs to get you to a surgeon.
item.realism.software.tip: Right-click a computer with it to install the app.
item.realism.model.tip: Ready-built: just give it redstone power. (Look-alike, not an official product.)
realism.snake.over: Game over! Space to play again
block.realism.color_classic_1993.tip: Inspired by the 1993 Macintosh Color Classic
block.realism.cube_2000.tip: Inspired by the 2000 Power Mac G4 Cube
block.realism.mini_m1.tip: Inspired by the Mac mini with the M1 chip
block.realism.mini_m2.tip: Inspired by the Mac mini with the M2 chip
block.realism.mini_m3.tip: Inspired by the Mac mini with the M3 chip
block.realism.mini_m4.tip: Inspired by the Mac mini with the M4 chip
block.realism.mini_m5.tip: Inspired by the Mac mini line, with an M5-style chip
block.realism.mini_m6.tip: A future model: no real M6 Mac mini existed when this was made
realism.atm.exchanged: Swapped %s emeralds: you got %s (after tax). Balance: %s
realism.atm.too_little: You need at least %s to withdraw a banknote.
realism.flag.not_leader: Only a country's leader can place its flag. (/country create <name>)
realism.country.created: You founded %s! You're its leader. Place a Country Flag to claim land.
realism.country.cant_create: You're already in a country, or that name is taken.
realism.country.cant_join: No such country, or you're already in one.
realism.country.cant_leave: You're not in a country (a leader can't leave their own).
realism.country.not_leader: Only the leader can do that.
realism.country.cant_withdraw: Only the leader can, and the treasury needs enough money.
realism.country.none: You're not in a country. /country create <name> or /country join <name>
realism.phone.no_signal: No signal! Get within range of a Signal Tower.
realism.phone.unreachable: They have no phone or no signal.
realism.phone.ambulance_failed: The ambulance couldn't help (nobody collapsed nearby, or no hospital).
realism.dream.1: You dreamed you could fly over the clouds.
realism.nightmare.1: Nightmare: you were falling, and the ground never came.
realism.dream.2: You dreamed about a warm summer day with no snow at all.
realism.nightmare.2: Nightmare: a tornado followed you and wouldn't stop.
realism.dream.3: You dreamed you found a whole cave of diamonds.
realism.nightmare.3: Nightmare: something chased you through the dark.
realism.dream.4: You dreamed about a huge feast with all your friends.
realism.nightmare.4: Nightmare: you were lost in an endless yellow maze.
realism.dream.5: You dreamed you were watching the stars from a quiet hill.
realism.nightmare.5: Nightmare: the cold kept getting closer and closer.
realism.dream.6: You dreamed about building the coolest house ever.
realism.nightmare.6: Nightmare: everyone you called just didn't hear you.
realism.dream.7: You dreamed a friendly wolf walked beside you.
realism.nightmare.7: Nightmare: your house was empty, and the door wouldn't open.
realism.dream.8: You dreamed you were floating in a calm, warm sea.
realism.nightmare.8: Nightmare: eyes in the dark, watching you.
item.realism.raw_uranium.tip: Radioactive! Don't carry it around for long.
item.realism.geiger_counter.tip: Hold it: the faster it clicks, the more radiation.
item.realism.anti_radiation_pills.tip: Halve the radiation you take in for 10 minutes.
item.realism.chemotherapy.tip: Treats cancer. Often pushes it back a stage; you'll feel rough for a while.
item.realism.hammer.tip: Hold it to craft at a Workbench.
realism.era.screen.title: Where does history start?
realism.era.screen.year0_info: Year 0: invent everything yourselves. Black and white, brutal, no modern medicine.
realism.era.screen.today_info: 2026: today's world, everything is already invented.
realism.era.chose_0: History starts at year 0. Invent things to move time forward!
realism.era.colour: Colour TV is here: the world has colour again!
realism.era.medicine: Modern medicine is here: surgery, defibrillators and transfusions now work.
realism.era.no_medicine: It's the year %s: modern medicine isn't invented yet (build a Medical Station).
realism.era.not_chosen: No era picked yet (it's %s). An operator can use /era start year0 or today.
realism.flu.caught: You caught the flu. Rest, keep warm, or take flu medicine.
realism.food_poisoning.start: Your stomach doesn't feel right... food poisoning. Drink water.
realism.infection.start: The wound got infected. You need antibiotics or a doctor.
realism.cancer.tired: You've been feeling very tired lately. Maybe see a doctor and get a scan.
realism.cancer.removed: The surgeon removed the cancer. You're cancer-free!
realism.pills.antibiotics: The antibiotics are fighting the infection. It's gone.
realism.pills.flu: You'll feel better in a few minutes.
realism.chemo.worked: The chemotherapy worked: the cancer shrank a stage.
realism.chemo.cured: The chemotherapy worked: no more cancer!
realism.chemo.again: This round didn't shrink it. Don't give up, try another round.
realism.scanner.title: 🩻 Scan results:
realism.scanner.cancer_surgery: Found early: surgery on the Operating Table can remove it.
realism.scanner.cancer_chemo: Treatment: chemotherapy (from the Doctor). There's always hope.
realism.power.grid: ⚡ Grid on: making %1$s W, using %2$s W (fuel: %3$s min)
realism.power.blackout: ⚠ Blackout: making %1$s W, using %2$s W (fuel: %3$s min)
realism.power.full: The generator is full of fuel.
realism.stove.love: Made with love ❤️ just like grandma's.
realism.workbench.hammer: Hold a Hammer to work at the Workbench.
realism.workbench.no_table: Real life has no crafting table. Build a Workbench (planks over logs) and use a Hammer.
realism.chat.voice_only: Typed chat is off: talk with voice chat! (Commands and phone texts still work.)
realism.fiberglass.cut: Tiny glass fibres cut your hand!
realism.surgery.implant_done: The Doctor put the implant in. You wake up a little sore.
realism.ambulance.not_invented: Ambulances aren't invented yet (make one to invent them).
realism.van.loaded: The paramedics load you in. Hang on...
realism.van.patient: %s is in the back. Get to the hospital!
realism.law.not_leader: Only a country's leader can do that.
realism.law.clean: %s has no crimes in your country.
realism.law.too_far: %s is too far away to arrest (8 blocks).
realism.law.arrested: You're under arrest in %1$s: %2$s minutes in jail.
realism.law.jail_outside: Stand inside your own country's land (in the Overworld).
realism.law.no_death_penalty: There's no death penalty in modern times (Czechia ended it in 1990).
realism.law.sentence_ok: The sentence for %s will be carried out.
item.realism.knife.tip: Food in your other hand + right-click: cut it.
realism.knife.modern: Modern times: your sword is now a knife.
item.realism.surgery_kit.tip: Use on a patient at an Operating Table, then stay close for 5 seconds.
item.realism.forensics_kit.tip: Use on remains, or with a weapon in your other hand, to find evidence.
realism.drag.start: Dragging %s. Right-click an Operating Table to lay them on it.
realism.drag.on_table: %s is on the Operating Table. Use a Surgery Kit!
realism.surgeon.no_table: The patient has to be at an Operating Table.
realism.surgeon.failed: Something went wrong: %s is bleeding! Bandage them and try again.
realism.surgeon.done: Surgery on %1$s went well! (Surgeries: %2$s, success chance now %3$s%%)
realism.surgeon.patient: %s operated on you. You wake up groggy.
realism.forensics.title: 🔎 Remains of %s:
realism.forensics.hold_item: Hold the item to check in your other hand.
realism.forensics.cause.body: thirst, hunger, cold or no sleep
